meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Azure RBAC (use azure-rbac), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI代理配置Microsoft Entra身份与OAuth令牌交换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Microsoft Entra中为AI代理管理身份和OAuth令牌交换。
copy.tagline_en: Provision Microsoft Entra identities and OAuth token exchange for AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage identities and OAuth token exchange for AI agents in Microsoft Entra.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建和管理 OAuth 2.0 身份。每个代理实例获得独立身份、审计跟踪和权限。
howto.when: 当你需要为 AI 代理创建身份蓝图、服务主体或实例身份，或配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换（如 fmi_path、OBO、跨租户）时触发。

say.text: 为我的新 AI 代理创建一个身份蓝图。
在蓝图下创建一个名为 agent-1 的代理身份。
给这个代理身份授予 User.Read.All 应用权限。
say.note: Claude 会为该身份分配应用角色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and manage OAuth 2.0 identities for AI agents via Microsoft Graph. Each agent instance gets a distinct identity, audit trail, and independently-scoped permission grants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, or per-instance Agent Identities, or configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).

say_en.text: Create an identity blueprint for my new AI agent.
say_en.note: Claude will call Graph API to create a Blueprint object.

say_en.text: Create an agent identity named agent-1 under the blueprint.
say_en.note: Claude will create an Agent Identity service principal.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All app permission to this agent identity.
say_en.note: Claude will assign the app role to that identity.
